row.team_price_text: Learn:Up: from $9/u/mo billed annually (based on a 200-person company)
row.evidence: WorkRamp's help centre documents SCIM 2.0 provisioning (base URL https://app.workramp.com/scim/v2) for Okta, OneLogin and Entra, but Confirm's pricing page lists only a 'Starting from $9 per user per month' Learn:Up price with a quote and never says which deals include SCIM.
row.notes: WorkRamp now sells as Learn:Up under Confirm (www.workramp.com redirects to confirm.com). The pricing page shows one 'starting from' price per product ($9/user/mo billed annually, based on a 200-person company) and quotes everything else; it names no tiers and does not mention SSO or SCIM. The help centre says SAML SSO is supported 'for select accounts', which suggests SSO and SCIM are not on every deal, but no plan gate is published, so the status stays unknown. SCIM uses the same admin-owned API key as the REST API, and the REST API is described as a private API that customers must request access to. SAML sign-in auto-provisions (JIT) users. HRIS connectors (HiBob, BambooHR, Workday) and CSV bulk upload are also offered.

plans.name: Learn:Up
plans.price_text: Starting from $9 / £7 per user per month, billed annually, based on a 200-person company
plans.notes: Single 'starting from' price with a 'Get a quote' button; Academy (customer training, also formerly WorkRamp) is quote-only.

auth.token_source: Admin > Integrations > API (API key management page); the key belongs to an admin user
auth.notes: Keys stop working if the owning user is deactivated, so a dedicated admin service account is recommended.

operations.notes: Deleting a user in Okta only deactivates them in WorkRamp ('but not permanently delete them').

deprovision.data_retained: User is marked deactivated, not permanently deleted; an admin can reactivate the account in WorkRamp.

custom.how: Custom attributes must first exist in WorkRamp; they are sent with the extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:workramp:2.0:User:<API name> (Entra) or as Okta profile attributes whose variable name equals the WorkRamp API name.

attributes.notes: userName (email) and schemas are the only required fields. managerName is sent in the core namespace from Okta and OneLogin; Entra uses the WorkRamp extension for manager and externalId. Group attribute names are not documented beyond group push.

limitations.text: Existing users created before SCIM was enabled must be unassigned and reassigned in Okta (with Deactivate Users temporarily off) before they receive SCIM updates.
Only the primary SSO provider can sync groups.
The Integrations hub says the SCIM documentation requires login, though the per-IdP setup articles are public.

auth.notes: Bearer API keys created by any admin on the Integrations > API page; no scopes, the key has the owning admin's full access.

capabilities.notes: Deactivate/reactivate via the isDeleted field on Update User; the only role setting is the isAdmin flag. A single user is fetched by filtering the list endpoint by email.

endpoints.purpose: List users (filters: email, name, custom_attributes, includeDeleted; limit/page)
Update a user (email, name, isAdmin, isDeleted, managers, custom attributes)
Assign a user to a group

webhooks_user_events.notes: Documented webhooks cover assignments and event-session attendees, not user lifecycle events.

rate_limits.text: Burst up to 13,000 calls/hour, hourly rate up to 3,000 calls/hour; Get All Users is limited to 10 requests per 60 seconds when paging (page size up to 100).

limitations.text: Described as a private API: customers contact support to check eligibility and request access.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push as checked; WorkRamp's guide adds the app from the Okta catalog.

entra.notes: No gallery app: WorkRamp's guide has admins create a custom (non-gallery) enterprise app for SAML and then point automatic provisioning at the generic SCIM tenant URL.

google.notes: WorkRamp documents SAML SSO with Google Workspace but no Google provisioning.

onelogin.notes: WorkRamp's own guide uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Core)' app; OneLogin's catalogue page was not checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS connectors for HiBob (daily S3 file transfer), BambooHR and Workday

open_questions: Which Learn:Up deals include SCIM and SAML SSO is not published ('for select accounts').
Whether the private REST API costs extra or is limited to some contracts is not stated.
SCIM PUT vs PATCH support, filtering, pagination, ServiceProviderConfig and rate limits are not documented publicly.
Whether SCIM deactivation frees a paid seat or ends active sessions is not documented.
Google Workspace and JumpCloud catalogue entries were not checked.
